title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-18

source: Source A: Master Audience Cassettes; unknown taper, unknown equipment > 1st generation reels. This source supplies several minutes of the crowd/tuning before "Bertha", as well as "Bertha" in its entirety. This source also supplies the balance of the show after Source B cuts towards the end of "Dark Star"  Source B: Master Audience Cassette; unknown taper, unknown equipment > 1st generation reels.
